novel_features.name: Newsletter compose
novel_features.description: Author a multi-section newsletter by fanning out across N chatflows in one command — perfect for an agent assembling a weekly market report.

novel_features.name: Predict batch fan-out
novel_features.description: Run a chatflow against a CSV or NDJSON of questions concurrently and stream back NDJSON results.

novel_features.name: Docstore folder ingest
novel_features.description: Walk a folder of source material and ingest every matching file into a document store in one call, then trigger vector indexing.

novel_features.name: Cross-prediction FTS search
novel_features.description: Full-text search across every recorded prediction with filters on time window, cited document store, used tool, and chatflow.

novel_features.name: Newsletter audit report
novel_features.description: Per-chatId audit report joining predictions, chat messages, and upsert history; CSV-friendly for compliance archives.

novel_features.name: RAG corpus drift report
novel_features.description: Show which document stores got new content this week and which chatflows reference each store.

novel_features.name: Prediction replay
novel_features.description: Re-fire a prior prediction by chatId; optionally diff the new response against the recorded one.

novel_features.name: Predict resume (HITL)
novel_features.description: Resume a suspended AgentFlow V2 run by chatId with a structured `humanInput` payload.

novel_features.name: Chatflow dependency graph
novel_features.description: Show every tool, assistant, variable, and document store referenced by a chatflow; flag missing references.

novel_features.name: Stale chatflow finder
novel_features.description: List chatflows not updated in N days, sortable by staleness.
